run.trigger: Operations asked the agent to work this case

steps.summary: Toyota Corolla for Calverin Car Centre, Oulu → Espoo. No driver assigned.
4 recent messages. Latest from Shift lead: “The first driver handed the car and keys to the staffed yard, but the second driver did not collect it.”
1 open alert (Original customer delivery window ends today, but the next confirmed yard release window is tomorrow. No revised customer delivery promise is approved.), no incidents, no open tasks.
no bookings; no quote or capacity checks (not bookings).

input.text: Car and keys are at the staffed Espoo yard, not released to anyone. The yard says it can release them to a replacement driver on 22 Oct between 09:00 and 11:00 after an ID and condition check.
Customer delivery promise is today 11:00–14:00 and will not be met. The car is in the yard until tomorrow's 09:00–11:00 release.

No driver is assigned to collect the car from the yard. The only assignment is Salla Pervalen's first leg, marked completed. Noel Jarnwell, who was due to collect, said they cannot make it and has no assignment on the order.
The shift lead emailed the customer to ask for a new delivery target. No reply is on record, and the promise in the order has not been changed.

input.title: Assign a replacement driver to collect the car from the Espoo yard on 22 Oct 09:00–11:00
input.rationale: The car can only leave the yard tomorrow between 09:00 and 11:00, and nobody is assigned to collect it. If no driver is in place, the car misses another day. The new delivery date should wait for the customer's reply to the shift lead's email.
